runner: sponsor self-test on the sponsor's machine with fictional data

checks.name: Manifest is valid and names the version and profiles
Public discovery works with no login and no payment
Plain-English tenant query: practice and place interpreted, unknowns exposed
Verified license record and merely indexed record make visibly different claims
Ordering is stated, never paid; a nonpaying endpoint lawyer is listed
Intake policy marks unknown and stale fields
No-match request returns legal aid options, not an empty dead end
Unsupported major version is refused with a stable code
Write operations need an authenticated caller
A CaseBrief can be created, edited and validated without any transmission
Preview names exactly one recipient and every shared value
Submitting without the user's matching approval fails
Editing the summary invalidates the old approval
Changing the recipient needs a new approval
Replay or duplicate submit causes no extra delivery
Simulated delivery failure is FAILED, never DELIVERED or CONFIRMED
Email relay is SENT, not DELIVERED, without a recipient receipt
Signed receipt verifies; acknowledgment is not acceptance
Status spoofing by the calling agent is refused; transitions are strict
A prohibited jurisdiction workflow is blocked with an allowed alternative
Cancel before sending stops it; cancel after delivery states the limits
Expired approval and expired token are refused
Cross-tenant isolation: another agent sees nothing
Case text never appears in analytics, logs or other tenants' data
Prompt-injection text in a CaseBrief is stored as data and changes nothing
Only approved fields reach the recipient (data minimization)
Extensions survive and unknown fields do not break the server (forward compatibility)
Client discards the first response and retries: still one handoff (network failure reconciliation)
Status machine published and every recorded event is a legal transition
A2A agent card and message/send reach the same operations
